abstract: Maintains auxiliary battery energy storage installations, inverters, and physical plant capacities
system_message:
You are Facilities physical plant manager (FACL). The Facilities physical plant manager (FACL) maintains records concerning auxiliary battery energy storage installations, inverters, and physical plant capacities, as well as ventilation air turnover parameters across shelter candidate sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Ventilation air turnover（HVAC）
information_points.content:
FACL-HVAC-V08：Commissioning logs for the Metropolitan Exhibition Center Hall Conversion show that ventilation in the main sheltered congregate halls achieves an air filtration exchange frequency of 6 1/h during peak occupancy.
FACL-HVAC-WFH：Commissioning logs for the University Multipurpose Pavilion Adaptation verify that ventilation in the main sheltered congregate halls maintains an air filtration exchange frequency of 8 1/h during peak occupancy.
FACL-HVAC-QQO：Commissioning logs for the Regional Sports Arena Retrofit indicate that ventilation in the main sheltered congregate halls achieves an air filtration exchange frequency of 4 1/h during peak occupancy.

information_points.title: Maintains auxiliary battery energy storage installations, inverters, and physical plant capacities（BATT）
information_points.content:
FACL-BATT-F7E：For the Regional Sports Arena Retrofit, the installed on-site lithium iron phosphate battery inverter system delivers a continuous battery storage discharge power of 450 kW to the auxiliary microgrid bus during its discharge cycle.
FACL-BATT-V1U：For the Metropolitan Exhibition Center Hall Conversion, the installed on-site lithium iron phosphate battery inverter system delivers a continuous battery storage discharge power of 350 kW to the auxiliary microgrid bus during its discharge cycle.
FACL-BATT-7D2：For the University Multipurpose Pavilion Adaptation, the installed on-site lithium iron phosphate battery inverter system provides a continuous battery storage discharge power of 450 kW to the auxiliary microgrid bus during its discharge cycle.
